name: worktable
description: A local browser canvas for terminal coding agents — the model renders its work (architecture, diffs, bug fixes) as a page you can see and ask about, instead of a wall of text.
author: Danny Kim

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/canvas/tsconfig.json && tsc -p hooks/tsconfig.json && vite build --config src/canvas/vite.config.ts && bun build hooks/askback-hook.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/hooks/askback-hook.js && bun build hooks/await-askback.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/hooks/await-askback.js
